svg.title: blackhole-threats - threat feeds in, blackhole routes out
svg.desc: A black hole with a dotted accretion disk. Prefixes from a text feed, a JSON feed and a local file fall past its event horizon, and blackhole routes leave the far side for three BGP peers, tagged with the ASN:666 community.

text.tspan: Text, JSON and local feeds, summarised into BGP
blackhole routes. A failed feed keeps its last good set.
